concept.text: A proof that every simply connected, closed three-manifold is homeomorphic to the three-sphere. Proved by Grigori Perelman (2002–2003); the Clay Institute awarded the Millennium Prize in 2010, which he declined. Sources given: https://www.claymath.org/millennium-problems/ ; https://world-of-mathematics.com/blog/millennium-problems-overview/.
